measured: The monthly donation share rose from 22% to 34% across the two six-week windows either side of the default change.
rationale: A twelve-point rise in the monthly share, with no corresponding drop in total completed gifts, is consistent with the default change increasing recurring giving rather than merely reshuffling it.

measured: Form completion rate for visitors who scrolled past the impact statement was 41% before and 40% after, a one-point difference within normal variation.
rationale: The falsifier for this recommendation, an unchanged completion rate, held: the impact statement above the form did not measurably increase completion.
